todo: Purpose: Preserve the named moon tree as a single visual landmark while ordinary plants reuse the hydroponic kit.

Visual brief: A broad organic crown held over a visible trunk and roots; pearly foliage catches sparse upper-left light. A crescent-shaped gap in the crown echoes the circle without turning the leaves into geometric tiles.
Widths and size: Crown 163–281 art px wide, body 222–340 high; roots/solid trunk occupy a much smaller authored footprint, not the full crown box.
Implement after review: choose authored anchors, exact collision and approved variant art; these cell envelopes are layout proposals, not measured sprite bounds.
The tree never grows outdoors on the lunar surface; keep crown uncut by viewport bounds and keep a visible clear route around its trunk.
Lighting: Upper left; material-specific ramps and directional planes; no mirror-only relighting.
